summary.text: Henry Giasson is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 29 who took office in December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Army veteran who served 24 years, he was born in Minot, North Dakota.

paragraphs.text: Henry Giasson was born in Minot, North Dakota.
He served in the U.S. Army for 24 years and has been affiliated with the VFW and AMVETS, according to Ballotpedia.
Giasson assumed office in the New Hampshire House on December 4, 2024.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November general election ballot for Hillsborough 29.
